curve.move_taxonomy_note_en: long rates rising faster than short — reflation / term-premium / fiscal repricing
curve.move_taxonomy_note_zh: 长端利率上行快于短端 — 再通胀/期限溢价/财政重新定价

alarms.en: Rates volatility (MOVE) leading equity volatility (VIX) — stress often transmits this way.
alarms.zh: 利率波动（MOVE）领先股票波动（VIX）— 压力常以此路径传导。

alarms.en: Euro periphery spreads widening from calm — watch for fragmentation.
alarms.zh: 欧元区外围利差自平静水平扩大 — 留意分化风险。

verdict_en: Bond health healthy (78/100), recession. Curve positively sloped. Credit normal. Rates-vol normal.
verdict_zh: 债券健康度健康（78/100），衰退。曲线正向倾斜。信用正常。利率波动正常。

forex.note_en: Rate differentials drive FX — the US 2y policy-path and the real-10y are the carry and value anchors; a US-favorable widening vs foreign rates is a USD tailwind.

commodities.note_en: Real-10y is gold's discount rate (inverse); breakevens track oil/energy; curve slope proxies the growth impulse for copper/oil.

bitcoin.note_en: BTC is a long-duration, real-rate-sensitive liquidity asset — falling real-10y + easing plumbing is a tailwind; widening credit / rising MOVE is a risk-off gate.

equities.note_en: Discount-rate channel (real-10y, term premium) compresses long-duration multiples; HY OAS widening is associated with equity drawdowns in stress episodes; this snapshot does not establish a lead; the SPEED of yield moves (MOVE) matters more than the level.

gap.lean_zh: 市场与美联储基本一致

fed_path.headline_en: Market prices ~3 hikes over the next 12m (funds 3.88% → 4.62%)
fed_path.headline_zh: 市场为未来12个月定价约加息3次（基金利率 3.88% → 4.62%）
fed_path.read_en: At end-2026 the market implies 4.02% vs the Fed's 4.10% median dot (-8bp — market ≈ the Fed). The near-term forward spread is positive — no cuts priced near-term (+0.92pp).
fed_path.read_zh: 在end-2026，市场隐含 4.02% 对比美联储 4.10% 的中位点（-8基点 — 市场与美联储基本一致）。近端远期利差为正——近端未为降息定价（+0.92个百分点）。
fed_path.note_en: Display / LLM-context only. The implied path is a market PRICE (the futures-implied funds rate), not a forecast edge, and repricing is REACTIVE — it moves after data and the Fed, it does not lead. Never scored, never an MRS leg. ZQ/SR3 = keyless CME futures; dots = FRED FEDTARMD (FOMC SEP median). Cite the CME/FRED.
fed_path.note_zh: 仅供展示 / LLM 上下文。隐含路径是市场价格（期货隐含的基金利率），并非预测优势，且重新定价是被动的——它在数据和美联储之后变动，并不领先。从不评分，从不作为 MRS 项。ZQ/SR3=无需密钥的 CME 期货；点阵图=FRED FEDTARMD（FOMC SEP 中位数）。请注明 CME/FRED。

dots.subject: sep_median_2026
limitations: participant appropriate-policy projection, not a committee promise or probability
participant appropriate-policy projection, not a committee promise or probability

intl_bonds.verdict_en: Global 10y avg 4.31% and rising (+40bp/3m) — a global tightening/duration-bear impulse. US 10y is 161bp above the GDP-weighted rest of the world and rising — the dollar's rate-differential anchor. EM hard-currency OAS 1.54% (rising).
intl_bonds.verdict_zh: 全球10年期均值 4.31%，3个月 +40基点 — 全球收紧/久期偏空动能。美国10年期较GDP加权的世界其余高161基点，利差走阔 — 美元的利差之锚。新兴市场硬通货利差 1.54%（走阔）。

forex.note_en: A widening US-vs-world 10y premium is a USD tailwind (rate-differential / carry channel); a narrowing premium pressures the dollar.

legs.note_zh: 长期国债价格在3/6/12个月窗口的时序动量。

legs.note_en: A steep curve pays positive carry + roll-down to hold duration; inverted = negative carry.
legs.note_zh: 陡峭曲线为持有久期提供正套息+滚动收益；倒挂则为负套息。

legs.note_en: High real yield = cheap bonds (good entry); negative real yield = expensive (the 2022 regime).
legs.note_zh: 实际利率高=债券便宜（入场良机）；负实际利率=昂贵（2022年情形）。

legs.note_en: A high term premium means you're paid to bear duration risk; a negative one is not.
legs.note_zh: 期限溢价高意味着持有久期风险有补偿；为负则没有。

legs.note_en: Rising copper/gold + breakevens = reflation = a duration headwind.
legs.note_zh: 铜/金比与盈亏平衡通胀上行=再通胀=久期逆风。

curve_trade.rationale_en: No clear steepener or flattener bias.
curve_trade.rationale_zh: 无明显陡峭或平坦倾向。

bond_compass.verdict_en: Lean long duration (lean +0.26, 60% of legs agree). Carry+roll ≈ 5.48%/yr; yields can rise ~68bp before a 10y loses money over a year.
bond_compass.verdict_zh: 偏多久期（倾向 +0.26，60% 分项一致）。套息+滚动约 5.48%/年；收益率上行约 68基点以内，10年期一年总回报仍不亏。
bond_compass.honest_en: Display-only positioning context, never scored. The same factors, backtested as a long/flat duration timer (reports/duration-timing-phase0.md), earn their keep through DRAWDOWN-CONTROL (MaxDD −18% vs −48% buy-and-hold), not reliable return-timing — the deflated Sharpe is marginal. Read it as 'when to stand aside', not a trade signal.
bond_compass.honest_zh: 仅供仓位参考，从不评分。同样的因子作为多/空久期择时回测（见 reports/duration-timing-phase0.md），其价值在于回撤控制（最大回撤 −18% 对比买入持有 −48%），而非可靠的收益择时——贬值夏普处于临界。应理解为“何时退场”，而非交易信号。

assets.story_en: HY OAS and S&P returns co-move inversely in this contemporaneous panel; widening is an associated headwind, not a proven lead.
assets.story_zh: 本同步面板中，高收益利差与标普回报呈反向共变；利差走阔对应逆风，但并非已证明的领先关系。

assets.story_en: Long-duration growth de-rates as the real discount rate rises.
assets.story_zh: 实际贴现率上升时，长久期成长股估值下移。

assets.story_en: Curve slope and XLF returns can co-move, but this panel does not observe bank net interest margins or prove a causal margin channel.
assets.story_zh: 曲线斜率与XLF回报可能同步共变，但本面板不观测银行净息差，也不证明因果性的息差通道。

assets.story_en: Rate-sensitive long-duration cash flows; rising real yields are a headwind.
assets.story_zh: 对利率敏感的长久期现金流；实际利率上行为逆风。

assets.story_en: A bond proxy — high yield, rate-sensitive; rising yields compete it down.
assets.story_zh: 类债券——高股息、对利率敏感；利率上行形成竞争压力。

assets.story_en: Floating-rate, credit-dependent balance sheets — credit stress hits hardest.
assets.story_zh: 浮动利率、依赖信用的资产负债表——信用压力冲击最大。

assets.story_en: Rate-differential / real-carry channel — a higher US real yield pulls the dollar up.
assets.story_zh: 利差/实际套息通道——美国实际利率走高拉升美元。

assets.story_en: The real 10y is gold's opportunity cost — the cleanest inverse in macro.
assets.story_zh: 10年实际利率是黄金的机会成本——宏观中最干净的反向关系。

assets.story_en: Dr. Copper tracks the growth impulse the curve slope proxies.
assets.story_zh: “铜博士”跟随曲线斜率所代表的增长动能。

assets.story_en: Breakevens and energy feed each other; growth + inflation impulse.
assets.story_zh: 盈亏平衡通胀与能源相互驱动；增长+通胀动能。

assets.story_en: A long-duration liquidity asset — falling real yields + calm rates-vol are a tailwind.
assets.story_zh: 长久期流动性资产——实际利率下行+利率波动平静为顺风。

bond_cross_asset.verdict_en: Real-10y 2.88% (+51bp/3m), curve 0.91pp, HY OAS 3.16%. 4 markets with a bond-associated tailwind, 7 with a bond-associated headwind right now.
bond_cross_asset.verdict_zh: 10年实际利率 2.88%（+51基点/3月），曲线 0.91pp，高收益利差 3.16%。当前 4 个市场呈与债券指标相关的顺风，7 个呈相关逆风。
